# license-for-all-works

> Comprehensive Restricted Use License for Indigenous Creations with Tribal Sovereignty, Data Sovereignty, and Wealth Reclamation Protections

## About

This repository is a **continually iterating legal codebase** developed by ᓂᐲᔥ ᐙᐸᓂᒥᑮ-ᑭᓇᐙᐸᑭᓯ (Nbiish Waabanimikii-Kinawaabakizi), enrolled member of the sovereign Grand Traverse Band of Ottawa and Chippewa Indians (GTBOCI), descendant of Chief ᑭᓇᐙᐸᑭᓯ (Kinwaabakizi) of the Beaver Island Band. It establishes legal precedent for Indigenous intellectual property protection through tribal sovereignty, treaty rights, and federal Indian law.

This is **not** a traditional software project. It is a living legal framework — versioned, iterated, and hardened like code — grounding Indigenous IP protection in:

- Pre-constitutional inherent sovereignty and treaty rights (1836, 1855)
- Federal Indian law (Supremacy Clause, trust responsibility, Indian canons of construction)
- International Indigenous rights (UNDRIP, WIPO GRATK Treaty, Nagoya Protocol)
- AI training prohibitions with graduated enforcement
- Indigenous Data Sovereignty (CARE Principles)

## Repository Structure

- **LICENSE** — The published, production version of the license
- **working-LICENSE** — Active development version with in-progress amendments
- **CONTRIBUTING.md** — Contributor License Agreement (CLA) under tribal sovereignty
- **Terms-of-Service.md** — Service terms under tribal jurisdiction
- **Privacy-Policy.md** — Privacy policy grounded in Indigenous Data Sovereignty
- **Tribal-Consulting-Agreement.md** — Consulting agreement template
- **Beaver-Island-Band-Founding-Charter.md** — Constitution and Corporate Charter
- **LETTER OF INTENT TO PETITION FOR FEDERAL ACKNOWLEDGMENT.md** — Federal acknowledgment petition
- **critical.md** — Mandatory repository standards and synchronization instructions
- **roadmap/tribal-roadmap.md** — Strategic roadmap for Beaver Island Band

## Key Legal Framework

| Layer | Authority | Source |
|-------|-----------|--------|
| Inherent Sovereignty | Pre-constitutional rights of Indigenous nations | Aboriginal title, self-governance |
| Treaty Rights | Treaty of Washington (1836), Treaty of Detroit (1855) | 7 Stat. 491, 11 Stat. 621 |
| Federal Indian Law | Supremacy Clause, trust responsibility | Art. VI Cl. 2, *Worcester v. Georgia* |
| Federal Statutes | IACA, CFAA, DTSA, Copyright Act | 25 U.S.C. § 305, 18 U.S.C. § 1030 |
| International | UNDRIP, WIPO GRATK, Nagoya Protocol | Arts. 11, 31; May 2024 Treaty |

## Iteration Model

This codebase follows a `major.minor.patch` versioning scheme:

- **Major**: Structural changes to legal framework, new sections, jurisdictional additions
- **Minor**: Case law updates, citation corrections, language refinements
- **Patch**: Typo fixes, orthography standardization, formatting

Changes flow: `working-LICENSE` → `LICENSE` → dependent documents (per `critical.md`)

## Current Version

**v3.1.0** (August 31, 2026) — Sync of dependent documents to the v3.0.0 license & verified law: CONTRIBUTING.md + Terms-of-Service.md collectively embody the v2.2.0/v3.0.0 work (Worcester corrected to 1832; 1855 reframed as beneficiary/successor; treaty-as-supreme-law case line + *Medellín* distinction; *Winans* reserved-rights; WIPO GRATK gate status; §1.8 "Pushing Precedent"; Aug-2026 AI case status; TAKE IT DOWN/NO FAKES; machine-readable notice metadata). LICENSE content and numbering unchanged.
